clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, apprentice warlocks use the Glyphs of Summoning to call a voidwalker. Transcribed from the ancient Tablet of Verga, the inscriptions draw one from the Nether into a summoning circle and bind it to the warlock’s service.

In the Cleft of Shadow, warlocks study the dark arts far from the prying eyes of the Warchief’s guards. For an aspiring warlock learning from Gan'rul Bloodeye, commanding a voidwalker marks an important step. The Glyphs of Summoning come from knowledge inscribed on the Tablet of Verga, and bridge Azeroth and the Nether. In Neeru Fireblade's tent, the warlock lays them within a summoning circle. They open a threshold and draw a creature of the Void into the mortal realm. Before Gan'rul teaches the final methods of binding, the warlock must defeat the summoned creature in combat.
